options.name: access_key
options.description: The access key required to authenticate with the Tenable.io API. This key can be set as an environment variable named TENABLE_ACCESS_KEY or passed directly to the module.

options.name: members
options.description: The targets that you want excluded from scans. Specify multiple targets as a comma-separated string. An individual IPv4 address (192.0.2.1) A range of IPv4 addresses (192.0.2.1-192.0.2.255) CIDR notation (192.0.2.0/24) A fully-qualified domain name (FQDN) (host.domain.com)

options.name: network_id
options.description: The ID of the network object associated with scanners where Tenable Vulnerability Management applies the exclusion.

options.name: schedule
options.description: The schedule parameters for the exclusion.

options.name: secret_key
options.description: The secret key required to authenticate with the Tenable.io API. This key can be set as an environment variable named TENABLE_SECRET_KEY or passed directly to the module.
